newsitem.title: USA: China president said to look into TCK smut issue.
newsitem.headline: China president said to look into TCK smut issue.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin has promised to look into U.S. complaints about exclusion of U.S. wheat from China because of the TCK smut fungus, Sen Dirk Kempthorne said Monday.
The Idaho Republican was speaking at a news conference with other members of a U.S. Senate delegation that visited China, Vietnam, Hong Kong and Taiwan.
He said he told Zemin that, while U.S. wheat was barred, grain from Canada, Germany, France and other countries where there was TCK smut fungus was allowed into China.

"His point was that he did not realize that China was being inconsistent with their policy on who they wera allowing to ship into China," Kempthorne said. "He said 'I believe in justice' and that he would look into this personally."
Kempthorne added: "We have now contacted the Chinese embassy and asked them for a followup to this."
Kempthorne and Sen Byron Dorgan, D-North Dakota, said the delegation also raised the question of other U.S. commodity exports, including pork, with the Chinese.
Dorgan said that additional Chinese commodity imports would be a solution to an "unsustainable" U.S. deficit in its trade with China.
